text: Forget the cheetah speed you've heard. Almost none of those numbers came from a wild cheetah, actually hunting.
A study published in 2013 put collars on five wild cheetahs in Botswana.
The collars logged position, speed and acceleration, on three hundred and sixty-seven runs, most of them real hunts.
They caught a top speed. And it is lower than the number you've heard.
Then the bigger surprise: most of the hunts never came anywhere near it.
So how fast is a wild cheetah, really? The measured number is in the full video. Tap the link.
